Leadership

Administration of Debre Markos University

Debre Markos University is governed through a structured administration that supports academic excellence, student welfare, research, and community service. The administration coordinates strategic planning, resource management, leadership, and institutional development across the university.

Office of the President

University Leadership

The Office of the President provides overall leadership for the university and guides institutional planning, governance, and decision-making. It ensures that academic, research, and administrative functions are aligned with the university's mission and strategic goals.

Academic Affairs

Teaching and Learning

The academic administration manages curriculum development, program coordination, teaching quality, student assessment, and support for both undergraduate and postgraduate studies. It works to maintain academic standards and strengthen academic performance.

Registrar

Student Administration

The Registrar Directorate manages student registration, academic records, enrollment services, transcript issues, grading and examination support, and student academic information systems. The registrar office is central to student administration and institutional records.

Research & Community Service

Knowledge and Development

DMU administration promotes research, innovation, consultancy, and community engagement partnerships. These efforts support applied learning, institutional development, and regional socio-economic progress through collaborative projects.

Administration Support

Institutional Services

Administrative offices support facilities, finance, staff affairs, procurement, student support, and general university operations. These services ensure that academic programs and university activities run efficiently and effectively.
